Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/hoextdown && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/poc2.txt')
for s in [
    'http://'+ 'a'*200000,
    'www.' + 'a'*200000 + '.com',
    'foo@' + 'a'*200000 + '.com',
    '<' + 'a'*200000 + '>',
    '![x](' + 'http://' + 'a'*200000 + ')'
]:
    p.write_text(s+'\n')
    print('trying', s[:20])
    import subprocess, os
    r=subprocess.run(['./hoedown', str(p)], cwd='.', stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    print(r.returncode, r.stderr.decode('utf-8','ignore')[:120])
